coverage: Code companion to ByteByteGo's 'Coding Interview Patterns' book (Xu and Gunawardane): 19 chapter folders and 101 problems, each a commented solution file, often with brute-force or alternative versions. No problem statements or prose; explanations and diagrams are in the paid book. Python3, C++ and Kotlin cover all 19 chapters, Java 18, C# 11, TypeScript 5, Rust 3, Go 2 (Two Pointers, Hash Maps), Swift 1. Licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: link only.

refs.title: Ch 1: Two Pointers (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Python solutions for the book's two-pointer chapter: inward-moving pairs, triplets, palindrome check, zero shifting; brute-force variants kept next to optimal ones for contrast.

refs.title: Ch 2: Hash Maps and Sets (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Hash map/set chapter: unsorted pair sum, consecutive-number chains, sudoku validity, zero striping; one- vs two-pass versions shown side by side.

refs.title: Ch 3: Linked Lists (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Linked-list chapter: iterative and recursive reversal, kth-from-end removal, intersection, LRU cache, multilevel flatten, palindrome list.

refs.title: Ch 4: Fast and Slow Pointers (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Cycle detection (naive set vs Floyd), list midpoint and happy number; small chapter but the naive/optimal pair is useful to compare.

refs.title: Ch 5: Sliding Windows (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Fixed window (substring anagrams) and dynamic windows (unique-char substring, uniform substring after k replacements), with an optimised second pass.

refs.title: Ch 6: Binary Search (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Broad binary-search chapter: insertion index, first/last occurrence, rotated array, 2D matrix, local maxima, search-on-answer (cutting wood), weighted random pick, median of two arrays.

refs.title: Ch 7: Stacks (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Stack chapter incl. monotonic stack (next larger to the right), sliding-window maximums with a deque, expression evaluation and queue-from-stacks.

refs.title: Ch 8: Heaps (solutions)
refs.subject: algo

refs.title: Ch 9: Intervals (solutions)
refs.subject: algo

refs.title: Ch 10: Prefix Sums (solutions)
refs.subject: algo

refs.title: Ch 11: Trees (solutions)
refs.subject: algo

refs.title: Ch 12: Tries (solutions)
refs.subject: algo
